newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha flat in inactive market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha flat in inactive market.

text.p: NWE naphtha was flat in a quiet market on Wednesday, traders said.
Traders said two high paraffinic content cargoes were available out of Britain.

They said offers for the material were around quotes high +$3 basis Rotterdam and +$4 basis Antwerp. The best bid, however, was around $3 basis Antwerp, and one major petrochemical buyer said they would not consider anything above +$2.0 basis Rotterdam for the material.
Pipeline spec material was bid at around $191 for June delivery.
Some traders said the bids were hypothetical and meant only to push the market higher while others said demand and crude price levels justified them.
"Naphtha's strength has lagged behind that of crude over the past few day's and ultimately the market is crude related so I would expect naphtha to move higher," said one trader.
Some traders said demand was expected to increase in June as petrochemical and refinery turnarounds drew to a close.
Swaps, meanwhile, were little changed with June paper quoted around $190/$191 and July $1.0 above. May was assessed at around $187.50/$188.50.
